title: Mean stable influence of a random Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and choose uniformly a function from the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{\pm1\}$. For each coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the expected stable influence of this function at noise parameter $1-\delta$ is $\frac{(1-\delta/2)^n}{2-\delta}$.
